C1.worst_defect: The home 'Before you start' block mixes my counter questions with developer requirements, so a shop owner reads 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12' and 'RXDB_PREMIUM' right next to 'one tab per till'. On a phone, the hero screenshot is cropped to the product grid ('Gif' cut off), and the cart and checkout never show.
C1.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start'; home.phone.01 hero screenshot

C2.worst_defect: The proof behind the two headline claims ('Read the acceptance test', 'Read the 200-send test') links to raw test source files on GitHub (offline.spec.ts, replay.e2e.ts). A non-developer gets code, not a readable result such as a dated run or a pass record.
C2.where: home.desktop.01 'Keeps selling offline' / 'Every sale lands once' cards

C3.worst_defect: A step that can break a live store sits in a callout above step 1 and is not one of the numbered steps: 'If your store uses @vendure/email-plugin, swap its order-confirmation handler first: see Set up email'. A developer working down steps 1-9 can skip it, and my till customers would then get web-shop confirmation emails.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.01 'Before a sale on a live store' callout

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting is where At the till sends cashiers for sync notices, but it mixes counter instructions with server-admin material ('match its errorCode', 'register_session_already_open', GraphQL tallyResolveNeedsAdmin mutations) and has no split by reader. Staff looking between customers for 'what do I do now' have to dig through it.
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 'Till updates line' and 'Resolve a sale the store kept part-way'

C5.worst_defect: In 'What it does today', two features get boxed cards with buttons and the other eight are plain text pairs, so the section looks unfinished. The cashier-sheet and closure screenshots sit as a card inside a second framed box with wide empty padding.
C5.where: home.desktop.01 'What it does today'; at-the-till.desktop.03 and .04 screenshots

C6.worst_defect: On a phone, the home header shows only 'Docs' and 'Live demo'. 'Quick start' and 'At the till' hide behind an unlabelled chevron, and the quick start is a 9-screen scroll (10,580 px) with no jump back to the step list except the top dropdown.

C7.worst_defect: A docs search for 'offline' ranks Troubleshooting first. At the till's 'If the internet drops' section, the one a cashier needs, comes after Quick start's test-offline line.

overall_worst.defect: The page my staff are sent to when the till shows a sync warning is half written for whoever runs the Vendure server (errorCode lists, needs_admin GraphQL mutations, LAN http CSP options). The counter action ('leave the app open, don't reload, keep selling, keep the printed Z report') is buried among server instructions.
overall_worst.fix: Open Troubleshooting with a short 'At the counter' list: each header notice and the one thing a cashier does. Move the errorCode list, the GraphQL resolve steps and the LAN http note under a clearly labelled 'For whoever runs your Vendure server' section, or onto Plugin setup.
